verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 103.0 (-0.6% in a day) and momentum is 40: prices are falling. 84s cost 700, 85s 2,200 and 86s 4,600. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-19T23:36:00+01:00}}.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-10-22T07:59:00+01:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,200 (1.05 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,600 (1.12 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,600 (1.20 coins per Item Score point), 88s 11,000 (1.33 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Ao Tanaka and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Ao Tanaka 76 Rare -65.7%; Michael Laudrup 88 Base Icon -32.2%; Vicky López 84 Rare -31.0%; Nadine Keßler 88 Base Hero -27.4%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Xavi Espart SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 34K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
